overview: The two categories of chromosomes in a diploid cell, split by what kind of traits they carry.
genZNote: Autosomes run the body. Sex chromosomes decide if you're running it as XX or XY.

aspects.label: Number in Humans
aspects.valueB: 1 pair (2 chromosomes) in humans — XX or XY.

aspects.label: Function
aspects.valueA: Carry genes for general body traits, unrelated to sex determination.
aspects.valueB: Determine the sex of the individual and carry some sex-linked traits.

aspects.label: Similarity Between Sexes
aspects.valueA: Identical in both males and females.

aspects.label: Inheritance Pattern
aspects.valueB: Follow sex-linked inheritance patterns (e.g. X-linked recessive).

overlay.examHighYieldNote: Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes total: 22 autosomal pairs + 1 sex chromosome pair.
overlay.memoryTrick: Auto = automatic body traits. Sex chromosomes = decide sex.
overlay.commonMisconception: Sex chromosomes do carry non-sex-related genes too (e.g. haemophilia genes are on the X chromosome).
